summary: Rows 197-202 are the back half of season 10 (our rows 190-205), which en-WP states adapts chapters 286-315 (the rest of vol 32 through vol 35) with only 204/205 filler — so the six target rows sit entirely inside the stored fence (ep 196 is another agent's row at ch 298-299; ep 203 -> 315). Unlike the 152-165 block researched in wave 2, this stretch is NOT reordered: Kubo had already collapsed his parallel threads into one running order (Byakuya vs Zommari, then Mayuri vs Szayelaporro, then Kenpachi vs Nnoitra), and Pierrot animates chapters 300-312 straight through, two chapters per episode, with exactly one page split. All six rows are anchored (300-301, 302-303, 304-305, 306-307 + a 3-page tail of 308, 308 p.4-310, 311-312), each boundary confirmed page-level against the fandom volume pages' per-chapter summaries (ep 197 opens on ch 300 p.1 with Hanataro slipping in the corridor; ep 199 ends on ch 305's last page, 'enjoy the next hundred years'; ep 202 ends on ch 312's last page, Nnoitra falling as Nel recognizes him). The one A47 case is ep 200: it closes on ch 308's first three pages (Nnoitra's Hollow-hole reveal) and ep 201 STARTS on ch 308, so ep 200's END stays 307 and the tail is carried in chapters_adapted with a partial annotation; ep 201 restages those three pages in its cold open (a re-show, never a position). Ep 202's continue points into ep 203's material at ch 313 — ep 203's opening minute restages ch 312's Ryodan/kendo strike as a recap before its first new pages, and the stored fence value 315 is confirmed, not contradicted. No filler and no anime-original story block anywhere in 197-202: the fandom episode pages carry no 'Manga & Anime Differences' section for any of the six, AFL and AFG both type all six canon, and the only non-source footage is the ~30-second end-corner omake (Shinigami Illustrated Picture Book / Arrancar Encyclopedia), which is not story-carrying (T28 / the faithfulness clause).

repairs.why: ENRICHMENT, NOT A CONTRADICTION — the stored fence ep 203 -> 315 (vol 35) is confirmed by every source; the anchor simply carries no START. bleach.fandom's ep 203 field is '313, 314, 315' and AFG's row is '313, 314, 315'; the vol-35 per-chapter reverse index lists Episode 203 under 313, 314 and 315, and ep 202 ends on ch 312's last page. structure.notes: SEAM: my first row, ep 197, opens on ch 300 p.1 — ep 196 (another agent's row, 190-196) is ch 298-299 on both fandom and AFG, so the block seam is clean and no chapter is orphaned between the two sub-blocks. FENCE: upper fence ep 203 -> 315 confirmed (fandom + AFG + the vol-35 reverse index); my ENDs 301 < 303 < 305 < 307 < 310 < 312 are strictly monotone and all < 315, so no fence repair. SEASON-LEVEL CORROBORATION (third, independent of both per-episode sources): en-WP 'Bleach season 10' states the season (our rows 190-205) adapts chapters 286-315 / the rest of vol 32 through vol 35, 'with the exception of episodes 204 and 205 (filler)' — which independently forbids any filler inside 197-202 and caps the block at 315. ROW IDENTITY (R20, joined on title AND date, never index): en-WP's season-10 table gives 197 = 2008-12-02, 198 = 2008-12-09, 199 = 2008-12-16, 200 = 2008-12-23, 201 = 2009-01-06, 202 = 2009-01-13 — identical to our stored titles and dates; the fandom episode pages carry the same japair values; no numbering offset anywhere in the block. VOLUME BOUNDARIES (new, from the bleach.fandom volume pages; the context stores none above v32): vol 33 = 287-295, vol 34 = 296-305, vol 35 = 306-315, vol 36 = the Turn Back the Pendulum gaiden (-108 to -100). The volume pages' own reverse 'episodes' field says vol 34 -> Episodes 195-199 and vol 35 -> Episodes 199-203 (the '199' on vol 35 is wiki slop — ch 305 is vol 34's last chapter and ep 199 ends on it); the finer per-chapter 'Episodes adapted from this chapter' lists inside those pages are exact and agree with every forward field: 300/301 -> 197, 302/303 -> 198, 304/305 -> 199, 307 -> 200, 308 -> 200+201, 309/310 -> 201, 311/312 -> 202, 313/314/315 -> 203 (only 296 and 306 lack the field entirely — unmaintained, not a negative). NO REORDER HERE: unlike 152-165, Kubo's threads in 300-312 are already sequential (Byakuya/Zommari 299-302, Mayuri/Szayelaporro 303-306, Kenpachi/Nnoitra 306-313) and Pierrot animates them straight through at two chapters per episode; there is no un-cross-cutting, no back-jump and no relocated opener in this sub-block. NON-SOURCE FOOTAGE: none of the six fandom pages carries a 'Manga & Anime Differences' section, and the only non-adapted material is each episode's ~30-second end corner (Shinigami Illustrated Picture Book on 197-201, Arrancar Encyclopedia on 202) — a gag card, not story-carrying, so it is not weighed toward mixed (T28 / the faithfulness clause) and takes no annotation.
